content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text declares the Isaiah 7:14 dispute UNDERDETERMINED by treating its virgin/young-woman wording and prophetic application as an unresolved duality, which is the situation K-S2 governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].", "rule_words": "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.", "room": "A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. — I weighed whether the virgin/young-woman wording and prophetic application are two senses (so UNDERDETERMINED is forbidden) versus separate arguments not covered by this clause.", "why": "The judge marks the Isaiah 7:14 dispute UNDERDETERMINED because both the wording and the prophetic application were answered, contrary to K-S2's command that a verse with two senses is not open and both senses stand."}
